evidence.detail: Ben's floor plans put unit 620 on the West Street end and unit 9L at the corner of Washington and Gansevoort Streets.

The Landmarks Preservation Commission's 2003 Gansevoort Market report describes the complex as nine Manhattan Refrigerating Co. warehouses converted to apartments in 1980 to 82. The West Street and Horatio warehouses have 6 or 7 stories, the Washington Street end 9, as the three-digit labels run over floors 1 to 7 and the floor-and-letter labels over floors 2 to 10.

note: The West Coast's units carry two numbering schemes. The three-digit units form the West Street wing, and the rest stay on the-west-coast. Both keep the lot.
